scope: V6.3 cohort research; no production strategy/config changes. UNKNOWN is preserved and counterfactuals are not signals.

combinations.note: Counts are a counterfactual proxy over the 18 setups that reached technical Entry. Potential/Entry Approaching are retained historical stages, not a re-run of missing orderbook/news.

reaction_analysis.note: Computed on post-formation prefix windows for recorded technical candidates. MSS/CHOCH uses the stored structure field; wick/engulfing/displacement are descriptive and not production acceptance.
